name: luna-shopper
//: Umbrella project for the Luna Shopper backend (plan 0013). It has no build; it only hosts the cross-service test-data orchestrator targets (seed / db:snapshot / db:restore). The services themselves — luna-shopper-auth, -core, -catalog, -gateway, -realtime — are their own nested projects under this directory. Pass args after `--`, e.g. `nx run luna-shopper:db:snapshot -- --label initial`.
